summary: The PrfPortfolio file is part of the HSPnet User Controls StaffProfile module. It involves managing staff expertise, interest, skills, and activities via a web interface. The file is connected to various controls and functionalities such as grid views, drop-down lists, and checkboxes for selecting and displaying staff profile data.
purpose: To facilitate the management of staff profiles, specifically to handle their expertise, interests, skills, and associated activities using a web-based user interface.

workflows.name: Manage Staff Profile
steps: Display and edit expertise, interest, and skill details
Handle add, edit, and delete commands for staff activities
Save changes and refresh view with updated information

business_rules: Auto-generate fields based on user actions
Ensure ScreenIsEditable condition for showing edit controls
Bind and select values in drop-downs based on user data
Display appropriate messages for empty data scenarios
validations: Ensure non-empty drop-down selections for skills and interests
Validate command execution only when Page.IsValid
conditions: UserSession must be active for data operations
Check for ReadOnly mode to disable editing capabilities
system_behavior: Switches between add, edit, and view modes
Handles file uploads and generates unique paths
Caches user session for consistent user experience
dependencies: Codes.CodeSearch for fetching skill and interest lists
exceptions: Cancel operation does not alter current page URL
Handle file operations safely to avoid file system clutter
